definitions.gloss: sweet spot; dead center; exact center of a bat or racket
definitions.explanation: The precise center point of a striking surface — the spot on a bat, racket, golf club, or similar implement where the hit feels cleanest and produces the best result. By extension, can mean hitting something right on target.

examples.japanese: ⟦バット→バット：11590_batto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真芯|ましん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{捉|とら}えた→捉える：12795_toraeru⟧。
examples.english: I caught it right on the sweet spot of the bat.

examples.japanese: {真芯|ましん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{打球|だきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: When you hit the sweet spot, the ball flies with a satisfying feel.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴルフ→ゴルフ：04731_gorufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{真芯|ましん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捉|とら}える→捉える：12795_toraeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、スイング⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フォーム→フォーム：29244_foomu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安定|あんてい}→安定：01703_antei⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧だ。
examples.english: To hit the sweet spot in golf, it's important to stabilize your swing form.

notes:
Composed of {真|ま} (true; exact) and ⟦{芯|しん}→芯：03888_shin⟧ (core; center). Primarily a sports term used in baseball, golf, tennis, and other bat/racket/club sports. Hitting the {真芯|ましん} produces maximum power transfer with minimal vibration in the hands.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真芯|ましん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{捉|とら}える→捉える：12795_toraeru⟧: to catch/hit on the sweet spot
- {真芯|ましん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧: to hit the sweet spot
- {真芯|ましん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧: to connect with the sweet spot (baseball)
- ⟦バット→バット：11590_batto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真芯|ましん}: the sweet spot of a bat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{芯|しん}→芯：03888_shin⟧: core; center — the general term for the middle or core of something
- ⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧: center — more general, used for any center point
- ジャストミート: perfect contact — loanword used in baseball for hitting the ball cleanly
